details:
For the past couple of days, YouTube links in AVPro-based video players all seem to load fine. However, in Unity-based video players, a YouTube link will produce the following error in the log:

- 2025.09.25 15:22:24 Warning    -  [Video Playback] ERROR: [youtube] 6Vpsum1DBCM: Requested format is not available. Use --list-formats for a list of available formats

- 2025.09.25 15:22:24 Debug      -  [Video Playback] URL 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6Vpsum1DBCM' resolved to 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6Vpsum1DBCM'

The video will then, of course, fail to play at all.

It seems this is not the first time this issue has occurred. What is it about the Unity player that causes it to have this issue? If it resolves URLs using the same method as the AVPro player, why do those links break only with Unity? It seems weird, but if there's a technical reason behind it, I'd be interested to know.
title: UdonSyncPlayer (Unity) won't play YouTube videos, AVPro appears fine
